user.title: NeoFrame Settings Server
user.description: Serves this frame's settings JSON (schedule, timezone, power profile, paused, image URL) at a URL NeoFrame polls as its Settings URL.

error.invalid_schedule: Schedule must be a valid, non-empty JSON array, e.g. [{"days": "daily", "start": "08:00", "stop": "22:00", "every": "5m"}]
